reference: AAC&U VALUE Rubrics; ETS Major Field Tests; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

description: Source system identifier for this SLO as stored in Ellucian Banner's academic history and curriculum modules. Used for ETL reconciliation between Banner (system of record) and the Databricks Silver Layer data product.

description: Domain of learning as classified by Bloom's Taxonomy: cognitive (knowledge and intellectual skills), affective (attitudes, values, and feelings), or psychomotor (physical and procedural skills). Supports comprehensive curriculum design and accreditation reporting.

description: Cognitive level of the learning outcome as classified by Bloom's Revised Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001). Drives assessment design and curriculum rigor analysis. Values: remember, understand, apply, analyze, evaluate, create — ordered from lower-order to higher-order thinking.
reference: Bloom's Revised Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001); AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3

description: Six-digit CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) code associated with the discipline of this SLO, following the NCES taxonomy (e.g., 52.0301 for Accounting). Used for IPEDS reporting, program benchmarking, and cross-institutional curriculum comparisons.
reference: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) 2020; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System)

description: Timestamp when this SLO record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail entry point for data governance, lineage tracking, and accreditation evidence of when outcomes were formally documented.
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Institutional Data Governance Policy; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

description: Type of instructional activity associated with the course section in which this SLO is assessed. Relevant for determining appropriate assessment methods and Carnegie Unit compliance. Values align with federal credit hour definitions under 34 CFR 600.2.

description: Indicates the level at which this SLO is addressed in the curriculum map for the associated program: introduced (first exposure), developed (reinforced and practiced), or mastered (demonstrated at capstone level). description: Instructional delivery modality for which this SLO is applicable. Some SLOs may be modality-specific (e.g., lab-based outcomes only apply to face-to-face sections). Supports modality-disaggregated assessment reporting required by accreditors for distance education programs.

description: The academic term in which this SLO first became effective, expressed as a four-digit year followed by a term code (e.g., 2024FA for Fall 2024, 2025SP for Spring 2025). Supports term-over-term curriculum change tracking and accreditation cycle reporting.

description: Reference to the specific HLC (Higher Learning Commission) Criterion for Accreditation to which this SLO contributes evidence (e.g., 'Criterion 4.B: The institution demonstrates a commitment to educational achievement and improvement through ongoing assessment of student learning'). description: Indicates whether this SLO is designated as a core or primary outcome for the course (True) versus a supplementary or supporting outcome (False). Core outcomes are typically required to be assessed every term; supplementary outcomes may be assessed on a rotating schedule.

description: Indicates whether this SLO is designated as a General Education (Gen Ed) outcome (True), meaning it contributes to the institution's general education assessment framework and may be reported to regional accreditors as evidence of broad learning competencies.

description: Indicates whether this SLO is associated with a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) designated course or program. Relevant for NSF grant reporting, IPEDS STEM program classification, and OPT extension eligibility tracking for international students.

description: Date on which this SLO was most recently reviewed for currency, rigor, and alignment with program goals. Accreditors require evidence of systematic, ongoing review of learning outcomes. Supports identification of SLOs overdue for review.

description: Free-text field for additional context, clarifications, or implementation guidance related to this SLO. May include notes from curriculum committee reviews, faculty feedback, or accreditor recommendations. Not used for structured data.

description: Full narrative statement describing the measurable competency students are expected to demonstrate upon completing the course. description: Name or code of the academic department responsible for maintaining and assessing this SLO (e.g., 'Department of Accounting', 'School of Engineering'). Supports departmental assessment reporting, faculty workload attribution, and accreditation unit-level reporting.

description: Minimum percentage of assessed students expected to meet or exceed the proficiency benchmark for this SLO, as defined in the assessment plan (e.g., 70.00 means 70% of students must demonstrate proficiency). reference: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

description: Code or identifier of the Program Learning Outcome (PLO) to which this course-level SLO contributes, enabling curriculum mapping from SLO to PLO. reference: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

description: Qualitative or quantitative description of the minimum acceptable performance standard for this SLO (e.g., 'Score of 3 or higher on a 4-point rubric', 'Correctly answers 75% of exam items mapped to this outcome'). Complements performance_threshold_pct with narrative context for accreditation documentation.
reference: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; AAC&U VALUE Rubrics

description: The academic term in which this SLO was retired or superseded. Nullable for active SLOs. Enables historical curriculum mapping and ensures retired outcomes are excluded from current assessment cycles while remaining available for longitudinal analysis.
reference: Ellucian Banner Curriculum Workflow; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

description: Reference to the specific SACSCOC (Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges) Principles of Accreditation standard to which this SLO is aligned (e.g., 'Standard 8.2: Student Outcomes: Educational Programs'). Applicable for institutions in the SACSCOC region.
reference: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation: Foundations for Quality Enhancement, Standard 8.2

description: Identifier mapping this SLO to a SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) learning objective within a packaged e-learning module deployed in the LMS. Enables automated tracking of objective completion data from SCORM-compliant content packages.

description: Institutionally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this SLO within the course or program context. Used in accreditation reports, curriculum maps, and assessment tracking systems. Example: ACCT301-SLO-001.
reference: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

description: Timestamp when this SLO record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trails, and curriculum change management processes.
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Institutional Data Governance Policy; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

reference: Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards

Current status of the VA benefit payment for the certified enrollment period. Pending = certification submitted awaiting VA processing, In Progress = VA processing payment, Paid = payment completed and disbursed, Denied = payment rejected by VA, Suspended = payment temporarily halted.

description: The total Cost of Attendance for the loan period, in USD. Includes tuition, fees, room, board, books, supplies, transportation, and personal expenses. Used to determine loan eligibility.

business_glossary_term: Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) Transaction Number

description: The timestamp when this loan record was first created in the Student Information System. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

reference: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

description: Classification of the loan product. SUB=Direct Subsidized Loan, UNSUB=Direct Unsubsidized Loan, PLUS_PARENT=Direct PLUS Loan for Parents, PLUS_GRAD=Direct PLUS Loan for Graduate Students, PERKINS=Federal Perkins Loan, PRIVATE=Private/Alternative Loan.

Indicates whether the student has an active registration hold at the time of this term record snapshot. Holds may be academic (probation), financial (outstanding balance), or administrative. Used for enrollment management and student services workflows.
Student's tuition residency classification for the term as determined by the institution's residency policy. Drives tuition rate assessment, state funding formulas, and IPEDS residency reporting.
reference: Ellucian Banner SGBSTDN; State Higher Education Finance Policy

description: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) status for the term as required by Title IV federal financial aid regulations. Evaluates qualitative (GPA), quantitative (pace/completion rate), and maximum timeframe standards. Determines continued financial aid eligibility.
reference: 34 CFR §668.34; U.S. Department of Education Title IV SAP

description: Operational system of record from which this student term record was sourced. Primarily Ellucian Banner (SGBSTDN/SHRTTRM) for enrollment domain. Supports data lineage and ETL audit in the lakehouse.

Broad academic level of the student for the term (undergraduate, graduate, professional, doctoral, non-degree). Distinct from class level — drives tuition rate schedules, financial aid programs, and accreditation reporting.

Student's Grade Point Average (GPA) calculated for the current term only, based on quality points earned divided by credit hours attempted with grade points. Protected under FERPA. Used for academic standing determination and Dean's List eligibility.
reference: Ellucian Banner SHRTTRM; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99; AACRAO

description: Total credit hours accepted from prior institutions via transfer credit evaluation. Included in cumulative hours for degree audit and class level but may be excluded from institutional GPA calculation per policy.
reference: Ellucian Banner SHRTTRM; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

description: Timestamp when this student term record was last updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse, reflecting grade changes, academic standing recalculations, or SAP status updates post-term.
reference: Institutional Data Governance Policy; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

description: Indicates whether the student is a veteran or active-duty military member. Drives VA education benefits processing (GI Bill), Yellow Ribbon Program eligibility, and veteran services reporting.
reference: 38 U.S.C. Chapter 33 (Post-9/11 GI Bill); VA School Certifying Official

description: Non-immigrant visa classification for international students. Required for SEVIS compliance reporting and determination of financial aid eligibility. Null for domestic students. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: F-1|J-1|M-1|H-1B|H-4|O-1|domestic|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

Number of courses from which the student officially withdrew during the term. Distinct from DFW count — used for financial aid Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculations and enrollment intensity adjustments.
Unique surrogate identifier for the academic term record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the term master table.

Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: Academic terms may have campus-specific calendars, registration periods, and census dates in multi-campus institutions. Term management and registration systems require campus assignment. Campus_code

Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Academic terms must align with fiscal periods for tuition revenue recognition, financial statement preparation, IPEDS reporting, and audit compliance. Every institution maps academic calendars to fisc

The academic year to which this term belongs, expressed in YYYY-YYYY format (e.g., '2024-2025'). Used for IPEDS reporting, financial aid year alignment, accreditation data submissions, and annual enrollment trend analysis.
reference: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; SACSCOC Standards

description: The last date students may add courses to their schedule for this term. After this date, course additions require instructor and dean approval. Critical for enrollment management, financial aid recalculation, and DFW rate tracking.
reference: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education

description: The native term code as stored in the Ellucian Banner Student Information System (STVTERM table). Serves as the integration key for data lineage tracing between the Silver Layer and the Banner SIS source system. Enables reconciliation during ETL validation.
reference: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; ETL Integration Standards

description: The institutional calendar structure under which this term operates. Determines credit hour equivalencies, ECTS conversion factors, and financial aid disbursement schedules. Reported to IPEDS and regional accreditors.
reference: IPEDS Glossary; ECTS User Guide; U.S. Department of Education

description: The official enrollment snapshot date used for IPEDS headcount and FTE reporting, state funding calculations, and institutional enrollment benchmarking. Enrollment counts frozen at census are the authoritative figures for accreditation and regulatory submissions.
reference: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education; NACUBO Reporting Standards

description: The date of the graduation ceremony associated with this term, if applicable. Used for degree conferral processing, alumni record creation in Blackbaud Raiser's Edge, and NCAA eligibility tracking for student-athletes.
reference: Ellucian Banner Graduation; Blackbaud Raiser's Edge; NCAA Eligibility Center

description: The timestamp when this term record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and FERPA compliance documentation for record management.
reference: FERPA; NACUBO Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

description: The official date on which degrees are conferred for students completing requirements in this term. May differ from commencement_date (e.g., degrees conferred at end of term but ceremony held later). Used for transcript notation, alumni record activation, and IPEDS Completions Survey reporting.
reference: Ellucian Banner Graduation; IPEDS Completions Survey; U.S. Department of Education

description: The last date students may drop courses without academic record notation (no 'W' grade). Drops before this date result in full or partial tuition refund per the institutional refund schedule. Impacts DFW rate calculations and enrollment reporting.
reference: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education Title IV

description: The last day of the academic term when instruction concludes. Marks the boundary for enrollment reporting, financial aid return-to-title-IV (R2T4) calculations, and academic standing evaluations.
reference: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; U.S. Department of Education Title IV R2T4; IPEDS

description: The scheduled date for initial financial aid disbursement to student accounts for this term. Must comply with U.S. Department of Education Title IV disbursement timing rules (no earlier than 10 days before term start for most aid types). Drives student billing and accounts receivable processing.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA Regulations; NACUBO Student Financial Services

description: The FAFSA award year associated with this term (e.g., '2024-2025'). Links the term to the correct FAFSA cycle for Title IV aid eligibility determination, Expected Family Contribution (EFC) calculations, and Cost of Attendance (COA) budgets.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA; Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

description: The minimum number of credit hours required for a student to be classified as full-time for FTE calculation purposes in this term. Typically 12 credit hours for undergraduates and 9 for graduates. Used in IPEDS FTE reporting, state funding formulas, and financial aid full-time enrollment requirements.
reference: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education; NACUBO FTE Reporting Standards

description: The last date by which faculty or academic administrators may submit grade changes (corrections or incomplete grade resolutions) for this term without requiring academic committee approval. Governs academic record integrity and transcript finalization.
reference: Ellucian Banner Academic History; FERPA; HLC Accreditation Standards

description: The deadline by which faculty must submit final grades for all courses in this term via the SIS or LMS gradebook. Triggers academic standing evaluation, Dean's List processing, and financial aid SAP review upon completion.
reference: Ellucian Banner Academic History; Canvas LMS Gradebook; HLC Accreditation Standards

description: The minimum number of credit hours required for a student to be classified as half-time enrollment status for this term. Typically 6 credit hours for undergraduates. Determines financial aid eligibility levels and loan deferment qualification under Title IV regulations.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA Regulations; Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

description: The deadline by which students must complete coursework to resolve an 'Incomplete' (I) grade assigned in this term. After this date, incomplete grades typically convert to a failing grade per institutional policy. Tracked in Banner Academic History.
reference: Ellucian Banner Academic History; HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC

description: The number of weeks of scheduled instruction in this term. Used for credit hour compliance verification per U.S. Department of Education regulations (Carnegie Unit standard: 1 credit hour = 1 hour of instruction + 2 hours of out-of-class work per week for 15 weeks), ECTS conversion, and accreditation reporting.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Credit Hour Definition (34 CFR 600.2); ECTS User Guide; HLC

description: Primary instructional delivery modality for this term. Reported to IPEDS and accreditors. 'Hyflex' indicates simultaneous in-person and online delivery. Drives distance education compliance reporting under U.S. Department of Education regulations.
reference: IPEDS Distance Education Definition; U.S. Department of Education; HLC Distance Education Standards

business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Term Type Code
description: IPEDS-defined term type code for federal enrollment reporting: '1' = Fall, '2' = Spring, '3' = Summer. Required for IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey and 12-Month Enrollment Survey submissions to the U.S. Department of Education.
reference: IPEDS Data Collection System; U.S. Department of Education IPEDS Glossary

description: Indicates whether credits earned in this term count toward degree completion requirements. Non-degree-applicable terms (e.g., certain continuing education sessions) are excluded from academic progress calculations and transcript degree audits.
reference: Ellucian Banner Academic History; HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC

description: Indicates whether students enrolled in this term are eligible to receive Title IV federal financial aid disbursements. Some special sessions or non-credit terms may not qualify. Governs FAFSA processing and aid packaging in Banner Financial Aid.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA Regulations; Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

description: Indicates whether this term uses open/rolling enrollment (True) rather than a fixed registration window (False). Relevant for MOOC-style programs, continuing education, and competency-based education offerings that do not follow traditional term calendars.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Competency-Based Education Guidelines; HLC

description: Indicates whether this term follows the institution's standard academic calendar (True) or is a non-standard/accelerated/special session term (False). Non-standard terms may have different financial aid disbursement rules and credit hour compliance requirements under Title IV.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Non-Standard Term Rules; Ellucian Banner

description: The last official day of academic activity for this term, used for Title IV Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculations when a student withdraws. Distinct from end_date as it may exclude final exam periods for R2T4 purposes.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Title IV R2T4 Regulations; Ellucian Banner

description: The deadline by which students must pay tuition and fees or establish a payment plan to avoid late fees or enrollment cancellation for this term. Managed in Banner Student Accounts.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts; NACUBO Student Financial Services Standards

description: The final date by which students may register for courses in this term through standard registration processes. After this date, late registration or departmental override processes apply.
reference: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); HLC Accreditation Standards

description: The date on which student course registration opens for this term. Priority registration windows for different student populations (e.g., seniors, athletes, honors students) are governed by this baseline date in Banner's registration control.

The date on which Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) is evaluated for students enrolled in this term. SAP evaluation is required by U.S. Department of Education Title IV regulations to determine continued financial aid eligibility based on GPA and completion rate thresholds.
reference: U.S. Department of Education Title IV SAP Regulations (34 CFR 668.34); Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

description: Sub-term session identifier used when a term contains multiple instructional sessions of different lengths (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C' for 8-week sessions within a 16-week semester, or 'S1'/'S2' for summer sessions). Aligns with Banner part-of-term configuration.
reference: Ellucian Banner Part-of-Term (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education

description: The first day of the academic term when instruction begins. Used to calculate enrollment duration, financial aid disbursement eligibility, and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) evaluation periods.
reference: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; IPEDS

description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the academic term, following Ellucian Banner's YYYYTT convention (e.g., 202410 for Fall 2024, 202420 for Spring 2025). Used as the primary cross-system integration key across Banner, Canvas LMS, and Kuali Research.
reference: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; IPEDS Reporting Standards

description: Human-readable display name of the academic term (e.g., 'Fall 2024', 'Spring 2025', 'Summer 2024 Session I'). Used in student-facing portals, transcripts, and institutional reporting.
reference: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; IPEDS Reporting Standards

description: Current lifecycle state of the academic term. 'Planning' indicates the term is being configured; 'Open' indicates registration is available; 'Active' indicates the term is in session; 'Closed' indicates the term has ended and grades are finalized; 'Archived' indicates the term is historical. Controls system-wide access and processing rules in Banner.
reference: Ellucian Banner Term Control Table; HLC Accreditation Standards

description: Classification of the academic term by season or session type. Drives financial aid disbursement cycles, IPEDS reporting, and enrollment analytics segmentation.
reference: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education Title IV Regulations

description: The date on which tuition and fee charges are assessed to student accounts for this term. Aligns with the institutional billing cycle and triggers accounts receivable processing in Banner Student Accounts and PeopleSoft Financials.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AR; NACUBO

description: The timestamp when this term record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.
reference: FERPA; NACUBO Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

description: The last date students may withdraw from courses with a 'W' grade notation on their academic record. Withdrawals after this date require academic committee approval. Affects SAP evaluation, financial aid return-to-title-IV (R2T4), and DFW rate reporting.
reference: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education Title IV R2T4; SACSCOC

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each waitlist entry record in the course section waitlist system. Primary key for the waitlist_entry data product.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Reference to the specific course section for which the student is waitlisted. A section is a scheduled offering of a course in a given term with an assigned instructor and meeting pattern.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.registration. Business justification: When a student is enrolled from a course waitlist (auto_enrolled_flag = true), this FK links the waitlist entry to the registration record that was created. This enables tracking of waitlist-to-enroll
Reference to the student who holds this waitlist position. Links to the student master record in Banner (PIDM-derived surrogate).
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Reference to the academic term (semester, quarter, or session) in which the waitlisted course section is offered. Supports term-based enrollment cycle processing.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS Reporting

description: The student's academic level at the time of waitlist entry. Used to enforce enrollment eligibility rules and section-level restrictions (e.g., graduate-only sections).
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS Reporting

description: Date and time when the student was placed on the course section waitlist. This is the principal business event timestamp establishing the student's queue position and priority.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for automatic enrollment into the course section when a seat becomes available, without requiring manual acceptance. Eligibility is determined by Banner registration rules, holds, and student consent.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Indicates whether the student was automatically enrolled into the course section via the Banner automated waitlist processing job, as opposed to manually accepting a seat offer.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Date and time when the student was automatically enrolled into the course section by the Banner automated waitlist processing job. Null if auto-enrollment did not occur.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Source system record identifier from Ellucian Banner Registration module (SFRSTCR/SSBSECT waitlist sequence key). Used for reconciliation and ETL traceability back to the system of record.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Institutional college or school code owning the course section (e.g., 'BUS' for College of Business, 'ENG' for College of Engineering). Supports college-level waitlist capacity and demand reporting.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; AACSB; ABET

description: Numeric or alphanumeric course number within the subject (e.g., '101', '301W'). Combined with subject_code forms the human-readable course identifier (e.g., MATH 301).
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Banner Course Reference Number (CRN) uniquely identifying the course section within a term. The CRN is the primary operational identifier used by students and staff during registration.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Date and time when the waitlist entry record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
reference: FERPA; Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Number of credit hours (CR) associated with the waitlisted course section. Used to assess impact on the student's total enrolled credit load and full-time equivalent (FTE) calculations upon enrollment.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS FTE Reporting

description: Academic department code responsible for the course section. Used for departmental waitlist management, override approvals, and capacity planning.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: The student's intended enrollment type for the waitlisted section, indicating full-time or part-time status and instructional delivery mode. Relevant for FTE calculations and financial aid eligibility.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS FTE Reporting

description: Current lifecycle status of the waitlist entry. 'active' = student is waiting; 'offered' = seat offer extended; 'accepted' = student accepted the seat offer; 'declined' = student declined the offer; 'expired' = offer deadline passed without response; 'cancelled' = student removed themselves or was administratively removed.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Disclosure Flag
description: Indicates whether the student has an active FERPA disclosure restriction on file that limits sharing of this enrollment-related record with third parties. Governs data access controls for this waitlist entry in compliance with FERPA regulations.
reference: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); U.S. Department of Education

description: Indicates whether enrollment from this waitlist entry would affect the student's financial aid eligibility or Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) status, such as pushing the student above or below full-time credit thresholds.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA

description: The grading basis the student intends to use for the waitlisted course section upon enrollment (e.g., standard letter grade, pass/fail, audit). Captured at waitlist entry to preserve student intent.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: The communication channel used to deliver the seat offer notification to the student. Supports multi-channel notification workflows in Banner and integrated CRM systems.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Indicates whether a seat offer notification has been sent to the student via the configured communication channel (email, SMS, or student portal). True = notification dispatched; False = not yet sent.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Date and time when the seat offer notification was sent to the student. Null if notification_sent_flag is False.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Date and time by which the student must accept or decline the seat offer before it expires and is passed to the next student on the waitlist. Configurable per term and course level.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Date and time when a seat offer was formally extended to the student, triggered by a vacancy opening in the course section. Null if no offer has been made.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Indicates whether the student's prerequisites for the waitlisted course have been verified as satisfied. A False value may block auto-enrollment even when a seat becomes available.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Descriptive reason for priority waitlist status when waitlist_type is 'priority' or 'department_override'. Examples include 'graduating senior', 'required for major', 'department chair approval'. Null for standard waitlist entries.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Indicates whether the student has an active registration hold in Banner that would prevent automatic enrollment even if a seat becomes available. Holds may include financial, academic, or administrative blocks.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; FERPA

description: Reason the student was removed from the waitlist. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enrolled|declined_offer|offer_expired|student_withdrew|admin_removed|registration_hold|prerequisite_failed — promote to reference product]
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Date and time when the student was removed from the waitlist, regardless of reason (enrolled, declined, expired, withdrew, or administratively removed). Null if the entry is still active.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Maximum enrollment capacity of the course section at the time the student was added to the waitlist. Provides context for waitlist depth analysis and seat availability forecasting.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Section identifier distinguishing multiple offerings of the same course in a term (e.g., '001', '002', 'W01' for online). Used alongside subject_code and course_number to fully identify the section.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: The student's explicit response to the seat offer: 'accepted' = student confirmed enrollment; 'declined' = student declined the seat; 'no_response' = offer expired without a response.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Date and time when the student responded to the seat offer (accepted or declined). Null if no response has been recorded.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Alphabetic subject/discipline code for the course (e.g., 'MATH', 'ENGL', 'CS'). Supports domain-level waitlist analysis and reporting by academic department.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; CIP Code Framework

description: Date and time when the waitlist entry record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks changes to status, position, notification flags, and offer details for audit and change-data-capture purposes.
reference: FERPA; Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Maximum number of students permitted on the waitlist for the course section, as configured in Banner SSBSECT. When the waitlist reaches this limit, no further students may join.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Total number of students on the waitlist for the course section at the time this entry was created. Provides context for the student's relative position and likelihood of enrollment.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Ordinal position of the student on the course section waitlist, where 1 indicates the next student to be offered a seat. Position is recalculated dynamically as students ahead are enrolled or removed.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Classification of the waitlist entry type: 'standard' = general first-come-first-served queue; 'priority' = student has been granted priority waitlist status (e.g., graduating senior, major requirement); 'department_override' = department-initiated placement bypassing standard queue.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

description: Unique identifier for each academic history record. Primary key for the academic history product.

Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Business justification: Course-level outcomes and grade distributions are accreditation evidence. Accreditation standards require evidence of learning outcomes assessment at course level. Essential for accreditation standard
Unique identifier for the course taken. Links to the course catalog master record.
Identifier for the specific section of the course in which the student was enrolled.
Unique identifier for the instructor of record who taught this section. Links to the faculty master record.
reference: CUPA-HR (College and University Professional Association for Human Resources)

description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_asset. Business justification: Tracks which lab computer, assistive device, or proctoring workstation was used for course delivery. Essential for IT asset utilization reporting, maintenance scheduling tied to academic calendar, and
Unique identifier for the student to whom this academic history record belongs. Links to the student master record.
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

description: Foreign key linking to research.irb_protocol. Business justification: Students in research methods courses, clinical practicums, or psychology labs often participate as subjects or researchers under specific IRB protocols; required for human subjects compliance tracking

Foreign key linking to research.principal_investigator. Business justification: Faculty who teach courses are often PIs; linking course instructor to PI record enables analysis of research productivity by teaching load, required for faculty workload planning and tenure review pro
Identifier for the academic term in which the course was taken (e.g., Fall 2023, Spring 2024).
The academic level at which the course was taken (e.g., undergraduate, graduate, professional, doctoral).
Indicates the impact of this course result on the student's academic standing (e.g., positive contribution, neutral, negative impact, triggered probation or dismissal).
The completion status of the course indicating whether the student successfully completed the course requirements.
The instructional delivery method for the course (e.g., in-person, online, hybrid, blended, synchronous, asynchronous).
The numeric level of the course indicating its difficulty or year level (e.g., 100-level for freshman, 200-level for sophomore, 500-level for graduate).
The unique course reference number (CRN) assigned to the section for registration purposes. Commonly used in Ellucian Banner systems.
The official title of the course as it appears on the transcript (e.g., Introduction to Psychology, Calculus I).
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

description: The number of credit hours the student attempted for this course. Used in GPA (Grade Point Average) and SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) calculations.
The number of credit hours the student successfully earned for this course. May differ from attempted hours if the course was failed or withdrawn.
Flag indicating whether this course counts toward the student's degree requirements for their declared program.
Flag indicating whether this course is eligible for financial aid consideration under Title IV regulations.
reference: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

description: Flag indicating whether this course fulfills a general education or core curriculum requirement.
Flag indicating whether this course is included in the student's GPA calculation. Some courses (e.g., pass/fail, audit, transfer credits) may be excluded.
The date on which the grade was last changed, if applicable. Used for audit trail and compliance purposes.
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

description: Flag indicating whether the grade for this course has been changed after initial posting. Used for audit trail purposes.
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

description: The documented reason for any grade change, required for audit trail and FERPA compliance.
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

description: The letter grade or grade code earned by the student for this course (e.g., A, B+, C-, F, W for withdrawal, I for incomplete, P for pass, NP for no pass, AU for audit).
The total grade points earned for this course, calculated as credit hours multiplied by the grade point value (e.g., 4.0 for A, 3.0 for B). Used in GPA (Grade Point Average) calculation.
Flag indicating whether this grade replaces a previous grade for GPA calculation purposes under the institution's grade replacement policy.
The grading basis under which the student took the course (e.g., standard letter grade, pass/fail, audit, credit/no credit).
Flag indicating whether this course was taken as part of an honors program or honors section.
Flag indicating whether this course fulfills a major requirement for the student's declared major program.
Flag indicating whether this course was delivered entirely online or through distance education.
Alternative term for grade points used in some institutions. Represents the numeric value assigned to the grade for GPA calculation purposes.
The timestamp when this academic history record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail purposes.
The timestamp when this academic history record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
The current or final registration status for this course enrollment (e.g., registered, dropped, withdrawn, completed).
The number of times the student has attempted this specific course, including the current attempt.
Flag indicating whether this course is a repeat of a previously taken course. True if the student has taken this course before.
The code or identifier for the institution from which transfer credits were earned. Populated only for transfer credits.
The name of the institution from which transfer credits were earned. Populated only for transfer credits.
The subject area code for the course (e.g., MATH, ENGL, BIOL, CHEM).
Flag indicating whether this course should appear on the official transcript. Some courses may be excluded from transcript display per institutional policy.
reference: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

description: Flag indicating whether this course was transferred from another institution rather than taken at the home institution.
Unique identifier for the academic standing evaluation record. Primary key for this entity.
Identifier of the staff member, office, or automated system that performed or certified the academic standing evaluation. Used for audit trail and accountability.
Identifier of the academic improvement plan assigned to the student, if applicable. Links to the academic plan document or record detailing required actions, milestones, and support services.
Identifier of the academic term for which this standing evaluation was performed. Links to the term reference table.
Unique identifier of the student being evaluated for academic standing. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

Indicates whether the student is required to follow an academic plan as a condition of continued enrollment or financial aid eligibility. Typically required for students on probation or whose appeal was conditionally approved.
The outcome of the student's SAP appeal. Approved appeals may reinstate Title IV eligibility with or without an academic plan. Denied appeals result in loss of federal financial aid eligibility.

business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Appeal Decision Date
description: The date on which the SAP appeal committee rendered a decision on the student's appeal.

business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Appeal Submitted Indicator
description: Indicates whether the student submitted a formal appeal for SAP suspension or probation status. Appeals typically cite extenuating circumstances such as medical issues, family emergencies, or other documented hardships.

The percentage of attempted credit hours that the student has successfully completed (earned credits / attempted credits * 100). Federal SAP requires a minimum 67% completion rate (pace) for Title IV eligibility.
reference: 34 CFR 668.34 - Title IV SAP Pace Requirement

description: The date and time when this academic standing evaluation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
Number of credit hours the student is currently enrolled in for the upcoming or current term. Used for enrollment status verification.

reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Primary category of the documented disability. Classified as physical (mobility, motor), learning (dyslexia, ADHD), psychological (anxiety, depression), chronic health (diabetes, epilepsy), sensory (visual, hearing), or other.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; HIPAA

description: Detailed description of the specific disability or condition as documented by the disability services office. May include clinical diagnosis or functional limitations.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; HIPAA

description: Date on which the supporting documentation expires and requires updating. Applicable for conditions that may change over time or when institutional policy requires periodic re-evaluation.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; HIPAA

description: Date on which the disability services office received the supporting medical or psychological documentation from the student or healthcare provider.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; HIPAA

description: Status of the supporting medical or psychological documentation required to substantiate the disability and accommodation request. Complete documentation meets all institutional requirements; incomplete documentation is missing required elements; pending documentation is awaiting submission; expired documentation requires updating; under review documentation is being evaluated by disability services staff.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Date from which the accommodation becomes active and available for use by the student in academic settings.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Date on which the disability services office determined the student eligible for accommodations under ADA Title II and Section 504 regulations.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Date on which the accommodation expires and requires renewal or re-evaluation. May be null for permanent accommodations or those without a defined end date.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Multiplier applied to standard exam time for students approved for extended time accommodations. Common values include 1.5 (time and a half) or 2.0 (double time). Null if extended time is not part of the accommodation.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Date on which the faculty member acknowledged receipt and understanding of the accommodation notification. Used to track compliance with accommodation implementation requirements.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Date on which faculty members were notified of the students approved accommodations. Faculty notification is typically sent by the disability services office at the start of each term or when accommodations are approved.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; FERPA

business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Sensitive Flag
description: Indicates whether this accommodation record contains information that requires heightened FERPA protection due to its sensitive nature. True if the record contains sensitive health or disability information requiring restricted access; false otherwise.

Indicates whether this accommodation record is currently active in the system. True if active; false if logically deleted or archived. Used for soft delete functionality and historical record retention.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Date of the most recent renewal or re-evaluation of the accommodation. Used to track renewal history and determine when the next renewal is due.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Timestamp indicating when this accommodation record was last modified or updated in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
Date by which the next renewal or re-evaluation of the accommodation must be completed. Calculated based on renewal frequency and last renewal date.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the accommodation, including implementation details, special considerations, student preferences, or coordination requirements. May contain sensitive health information.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; FERPA; HIPAA

description: Number of months between required renewals for accommodations that require periodic re-evaluation. Common values include 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), or 36 (triennial). Null if renewal is not required.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Indicates whether the accommodation requires periodic renewal or re-evaluation. True if renewal is required; false for permanent or indefinite accommodations.
reference: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

description: Indicates whether the student has been determined eligible for accommodations under Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973. True if eligible; false otherwise.

Name or identifier of the source system from which this accommodation record originated. Typically the disability services module within the Student Information System (SIS) such as Ellucian Banner or a specialized accommodation management system.

business_glossary_term: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Consent ID
description: Unique identifier for the FERPA consent record. Primary key for the ferpa_consent product.

Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: FERPA consents must align with institutional FERPA policy version. Consent forms reference specific policy language for legal compliance. Essential for consent validity verification and policy version
Unique identifier of the institutional staff member who processed and authorized this FERPA consent in the system. Links to the staff or employee master record.
Unique identifier of the student who granted or revoked FERPA consent. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).
Free-text field for institutional staff to record additional context, special circumstances, or compliance notes related to this FERPA consent.
Full name of the institutional staff member who processed this FERPA consent. Denormalized for audit trail purposes.
Primary email address of the authorized party for communication regarding record disclosures.
Full legal name of the individual or organization authorized to receive the student's educational records under this FERPA consent.
Primary contact phone number for the authorized party.

The relationship of the authorized party to the student. Indicates the basis for the disclosure authorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|legal_guardian|spouse|attorney|employer|financial_aid_agency|scholarship_provider|third_party_vendor|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
The specific FERPA release code activated in Ellucian Banner SIS for this consent. Maps to Banner's GOBTPAC table release codes.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - FERPA Release Configuration

description: URL or file path to the digitally stored signed FERPA consent form or authorization document. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.
The date from which the FERPA consent becomes enforceable and record disclosures may begin. May differ from grant date if consent is scheduled to start in the future.
The date on which the FERPA consent authorization expires and is no longer valid for record disclosure. Nullable for open-ended consents.
The date on which the student formally granted FERPA consent to the authorized party. Marks the beginning of the consent period.
ISO 639-3 three-letter language code indicating the language in which the consent was provided and documented. Supports multilingual compliance.
The date on which the student formally revoked the FERPA consent authorization. Nullable if consent has not been revoked.
Current lifecycle status of the FERPA consent authorization. Determines whether the consent is currently enforceable for record disclosure.
The scope of educational records covered by this consent authorization. Defines which categories of student information may be disclosed to the authorized party.
The date and time when this FERPA consent record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for compliance tracking.
The total number of times educational records have been disclosed to the authorized party under this consent authorization. Supports compliance monitoring.
Detailed narrative description of the specific educational records and information categories covered by this consent. Provides additional context beyond the consent_type field.
Version identifier of the institution's FERPA policy that was in effect when this consent was granted. Supports historical compliance tracking.
The most recent date on which educational records were disclosed to the authorized party under this consent. Used for audit tracking.
The date and time when this FERPA consent record was most recently updated in the system. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
The stated purpose or reason for which the authorized party will use the disclosed educational records. Required for FERPA compliance documentation.
Indicates whether this FERPA consent requires annual renewal by the student. Some institutions require periodic re-authorization for ongoing consents.
Narrative explanation provided by the student for revoking the FERPA consent authorization. Nullable if consent has not been revoked.
Indicates whether the authorized party is permitted to further disclose the educational records to additional third parties. Critical for FERPA compliance.
The date on which the student's identity and consent were verified by the institution.
The method by which the student's identity and consent authorization were verified. Critical for FERPA compliance audits.
Unique identifier for the student hold record. Primary key.

Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Financial holds reference specific AR ledger accounts for amounts owed (tuition, fees, library fines). Business process: bursar places holds when account balances exceed threshold; hold release requir

Identifier of the student on whom this hold is placed. Links to the student master record.
Academic year associated with the hold in YYYY-YYYY format (e.g., 2023-2024). Null if the hold is not year-specific.
Monetary amount owed by the student that triggered the hold, if applicable (e.g., outstanding tuition, fees, fines). Null for non-financial holds.
Date on which the student submitted an appeal. Null if no appeal was submitted.
Current status of the students appeal (pending, approved, denied, withdrawn). Null if no appeal was submitted.
Indicates whether the student has submitted an appeal or request for review of the hold (True/False).
Free-text comments or notes related to the hold, providing additional context or instructions for staff or the student.
Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the amount_owed field (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Null if amount_owed is null.
Indicates whether this hold blocks the conferral or release of the diploma (True/False).
Indicates whether this hold blocks the disbursement of financial aid funds (True/False). Critical for Title IV compliance.
reference: Ellucian Banner Student Information System, U.S. Department of Education Title IV

description: Date from which the hold becomes active and begins restricting services. May differ from placed_date if the hold is scheduled to take effect in the future.
Indicates whether this hold blocks the issuance of enrollment verification letters (True/False).
Date on which the hold automatically expires and is no longer active, if applicable. Null if the hold does not have an automatic expiration.

business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Protected Indicator
description: Indicates whether the hold information is protected under FERPA and subject to restricted disclosure (True/False).
Indicates whether this hold blocks the student from viewing grades (True/False).
Institutional code representing the type of hold (e.g., FIN for financial, ACD for academic, DIS for disciplinary, IMM for immunization, LIB for library, PRK for parking, COM for compliance).
reference: Ellucian Banner STVHLDD Hold Code Validation Table

description: Current lifecycle status of the hold (active, released, expired, pending, suspended).

Categorical classification of the hold indicating the functional area or reason category (financial, academic, disciplinary, immunization, library, parking, compliance, administrative, other).
